Select molecule_chembl_id as compound_chembl_id, compound_structures.canonical_smiles as canonical_smiles, compound_records.compound_key as compound_key, docs.pubmed_id as pubmed_id_or_doi, assays.description as assay_description, activities.standard_type as standard_type, activities.standard_relation as standard_relation, activities.standard_value as standard_value, activities.standard_units as standard_units, activities.activity_comment as activity_comment, target_dictionary.chembl_id as target_chembl_id, target_dictionary.pref_name as target_name, target_dictionary.organism as target_organism
Join activities on activities.record_id = compound_records.record_id
Join compound_records on compound_records.molregno = activities.molregno
Join molecule_dictionary on molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_records.molregno
Join compound_structures on compound_structures.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno
Join assays on assays.assay_id = activities.assay_id
Join target_dictionary on target_dictionary.tid = activities.tid
Filter activities.standard_type = 'IC50' and activities.standard_relation = '=' and activities.standard_value is not null and activities.standard_units = 'nM' and target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL2409'
Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism
Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism
